svg.aria-label: Minkowski wobble for lattice sets A and E against the settling non-lattice set D
svg.title: Minkowski wobble for lattice sets A and E against the settling non-lattice set D

g.text: The wobble dial: blur a fractal by ε and measure, then rescale by ε^½
Lattice sets (every zoom a power of one ratio) never settle: they have complex dimensions ½ + i·2πn/ln(1/r),
which act like a phase that turns as you zoom. D's zooms share no power (Lean: uneven_not_lattice), so it settles.
